title: How You Can Lose More Than 100%

beats.text: You think the most you can lose on a trade is a hundred percent. Not if you short.
Buy a share at ten dollars, and the worst case is it goes to zero. You lose ten dollars.
Shorting is the opposite. You borrow a share, sell it for ten dollars, and promise to buy it back later.
If it falls to two, you win eight. But there's no ceiling on how high it can go.
Twenty dollars? You've lost a hundred percent. Fifty? Four hundred percent.
In January twenty twenty-one, GameStop went from about twenty dollars to four hundred and eighty-three in under three weeks.
Short at twenty, buy back at four eighty-three? That's a loss of more than two thousand three hundred percent.
